title: dedicated-autoscaler-burst-util-reporting-enhancement
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Customers running Redwood Dedicated asked for better visibility into burst/autoscale behavior during short-lived traffic spikes. Current utilization reports aggregate across minutes and hide token-burst events that cause unexpected throttling or fallback. This PR adds finer-grained burst utilization metrics, ties them to tokenbucket state, and surfaces autoscaler decisions in the fleet dashboard.

Summary:
- Add per-fleet burst windows and tokenbucket-level utilization metrics (1s/5s/30s windows).
- Emit autoscaler decision events (scale_up/scale_down/throttle) with reason tags and current queue/backpressure state.
- Extend existing utilization reporting pipeline (telemetry->pipeline->warehouse) to include burst metrics and enrich the per-fleet usage API.
- Backfill adapter to stitch burst events into the console timeline and new per-fleet report widget.

Commits (high-level):
- a1b2c3d: telemetry: add burst_window metrics and tokenbucket_state tags
- d4e5f6a: autoscaler: emit decision events and include recent_queue_length, available_tokens
- b7c8d9e: reporting: pipe burst metrics through event-transform and normalize schema
- f0e1a2b: console: add Fleet -> Burst Utilization panel + API changes
- c3d4e5f: tests: unit + integration for new metrics and pipeline routing

Files changed (high-level):
- internal/telemetry/src/metrics/burst_metrics.rs (new)
- internal/autoscaler/src/events.rs (emit decision events)
- internal/reporting/transformers/burst_normalizer.py (normalize + tags)
- internal/console/api/fleet_reports.go (new endpoints)
- internal/console/frontend/src/components/FleetBurstPanel.tsx (ui)
- infra/telemetry/pipeline.yml (route updates)
- tests/integration/test_burst_reporting.py (integration)

Testing & CI:
- Added unit tests for metric formatting and autoscaler decision payloads.
- Integration test simulates traffic spike and asserts events surface in the console API within 10s.
- CI: build (pass), unit-tests (pass), integration (flaky -> rerun once -> pass), lint (pass).
- ci_status: pass.

Review & discussion (summary):
- @Liam Chen: requested clearer naming for 1s vs 5s windows and suggested moving config to autoscaler configmap instead of hardcoded constants. Author updated commit to read window sizes from 'fleet.autoscaler.burst_windows' (defaults 1,5,30).
- @Mariana Gomez: asked for privacy check around event payloads; confirmed no PII and added a filtering step in burst_normalizer.
- @Ethan Park: flagged potential perf impact of emitting events per-decision at high QPS. We added rate-limiting in telemetry (max 10 events/s per-fleet aggregated) and a sampling note in console.
- QA: validated end-to-end on staging (staging-fleet-3) with short bursts and verified UI graphs.

Merge: Squash merge after approvals. Merged by @Aisha Patel.

Notes: This PR aims to improve observability without changing autoscaler core algorithms; no behavioral changes to scaling logic other than emitting events and adding read-only metrics. Future work: expose burst window knobs in the Console config panel and add alerting rules for sustained bursts.

Related: Linear ENG-3245, ENG-4120.

Release notes: Adds burst utilization reporting for Dedicated fleets (1s/5s/30s windows) and autoscaler decision event visibility in the Fleet dashboard.
